beforeImage.name: Gopher Resource, LLC
beforeImage.description: Gopher Resource recycles lead-acid batteries and related materials, producing recycled lead and polypropylene for battery manufacturers and industrial customers. Its operations are asset-heavy, anchored by large recycling plants in Eagan, Minnesota and Tampa, Florida, and supported by a nationwide battery collection network. The company describes itself as a long-established industrial recycler with approximately 80 years of operating history. Public materials indicate that it recycled about 600 million pounds of lead and 41 million pounds of plastic in 2025. Energy Capital Partners announced the acquisition of Gopher Resource in 2018 and remains the publicly disclosed owner.

afterImage.name: Gopher Resource
afterImage.description: Gopher Resource is the operating name of Gopher Resource, LLC, a U.S. lead-battery recycling platform founded in 1946 and headquartered in Eagan, Minnesota. ECP's Energy Capital Partners IV-A, LP acquired the company in a transaction announced January 30 and closed March 6, 2018. A 2025 federal disclosure identifies ECP Gopher Holdings, LP as the sole immediate parent; the ECP economic interest, purchase price, rollover and co-investors are not publicly disclosed. Gopher operates recycling plants in Eagan and Tampa under mostly fixed, multi-year fee-for-service arrangements and reported processing more than 24 million batteries annually, employing more than 625 people, and recovering more than 41 million pounds of plastic and approximately 600 million pounds of lead in 2025. EnviroFocus, Resource Plastics, the facilities and The Recycling Zone remain subsidiaries, assets or operated sites rather than separate PortCos. A 2020 internal ECP HSR notice and the October 2024 US$450 million refinancing do not establish an outside-party exit, and no later sale or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 19, 2026.
